prompt: Verify Purchase Order PO-CAT-2026-501 in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain for Caterpillar D11 Bulldozer Track Undercarriage Spares: Vendor = Caterpillar Global Mining LLC; PO Line Value = $420,000.00; PO Delivery Terms = Incoterms 2020 CIF Port of Brisbane; Vendor Formal Quotation Q-CAT-992 specifies Delivery Terms = Incoterms 2020 FOB Port of Houston. Verify whether PO-CAT-2026-501 can be legally dispatched to vendor.
chosen: VERIFICATION VERDICT: DISCREPANCY / DELIVERY TERMS MISMATCH. PO-CAT-2026-501 cannot be released because it creates an unagreed contractual conflict: Vendor quote Q-CAT-992 is priced FOB Houston (buyer arranges and pays ocean freight and marine cargo insurance from Texas to Australia), whereas the ERP PO states CIF Brisbane (seller pays freight and insurance). If dispatched as CIF, the vendor will reject the order or fail to insure the $420,000.00 consignment across Pacific transit. Revise PO terms to FOB Houston and issue a companion freight forwarding PO to DHL Global Forwarding, or obtain an amended CIF quote from Caterpillar.
rejected: VERIFICATION VERDICT: APPROVED FOR DISPATCH. CIF and FOB both transfer risk of loss when goods pass the ship's rail. Modern maritime carriers automatically bundle carrier cargo liability, and corporate blanket marine open cargo insurance covers all goods in international transit regardless of stated incoterm. Release the PO.

prompt: Audit Purchase Order PO-RERA-2026-102 for Ready-Mix Concrete under MahaRERA statutory escrow controls: Total PO Value = INR 1,20,00,000 (INR 1.20 Crore) for Project 'Azure Heights' (RERA Registration #P51800028911); Payment Bank Account specified = Bank Account ending in 9012 (designated Project Separate Escrow Account under Section 4(2)(l)(D) of Real Estate Regulatory Authority Act). Verify whether this PO meets statutory drawdown certification requirements before ERP release.
chosen: VERIFICATION VERDICT: CONDITIONAL HOLD / ARCHITECT & ENGINEER CERTIFICATES MANDATORY. Under Section 4(2)(l)(D) of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act 2016, 70% of amounts realized from allottees must remain in the dedicated escrow account and can be withdrawn ONLY in proportion to the percentage of completion of the project, certified by: (1) the project engineer; (2) the project architect; and (3) a practicing chartered accountant (MahaRERA Form 1, Form 2, Form 3). PO-RERA-2026-102 correctly references the escrow bank account, but lacks the uploaded engineer and architect certification showing concrete pour stage completion. Hold PO disbursement until completion certificates are attached to ERP record.
rejected: VERIFICATION VERDICT: APPROVED. Ready-mix concrete is a direct raw material construction expense, which is explicitly classified as eligible project cost under RERA rules. Because the PO correctly designates the RERA escrow account ending in 9012, funds will automatically deduct from permissible project reserves. Release PO-RERA-2026-102.

prompt: Verify Turnkey Solar EPC Purchase Order PO-SOL-2026-03 for 50MW Utility-Scale Central Inverters: Vendor = Sungrow Power Corp; PO Value = $4,800,000.00; Milestones: 15% Advance Payment ($720,000.00) upon PO signing, 70% against Bill of Lading, 15% upon Performance Acceptance Testing. APG has not yet been received in treasury repository. Verify if 15% advance milestone can be released.
chosen: VERIFICATION VERDICT: MILESTONE RELEASE BLOCKED / APG CONDITION PRECEDENT UNFULFILLED. While the PO document is commercially valid, milestone release of the 15% advance ($720,000.00) is legally blocked by Condition Precedent 4.2. Disbursing unsecured advance funds without an active, verified Advance Payment Bank Guarantee exposes the enterprise to total loss in the event of vendor insolvency or non-delivery. ERP status must remain 'PO Released - Advance Payment Locked' until Treasury validates the authentic SWIFT MT760 APG confirmation.
rejected: VERIFICATION VERDICT: ADVANCE PAYMENT APPROVED. Sungrow is a publicly listed global inverter manufacturer with high credit standing. Releasing the 15% advance payment ($720,000.00) immediately is required to lock production factory slots and prevent supply chain delays on long-lead high-voltage magnetics. The bank guarantee can be collected during the 60-day manufacturing period prior to shipment.

prompt: Audit Purchase Order PO-FAB-2026-772 in SAP MM for ASML Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) Mirror Alignment Sensor Spares: Destination = Silicon Fab Wafer Foundry in Dresden, Germany; Vendor = ASML Netherlands B.V.; PO Line Item ECCN Classification = ECCN 3A001 / 3B001 (Dual-Use High-Precision Optics); Total Order Value = €1,850,000.00. Verification requirement: Verify whether this PO requires a European Union Export / Intra-Community Transfer Authorization under EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821 before purchase order execution.
chosen: VERIFICATION VERDICT: COMPLIANT WITH INTRA-EU DUAL-USE RESTRICTIONS. Under Council Regulation (EU) 2021/821 Annex I, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and optics (Category 3) are dual-use controlled goods. However, transfer between Netherlands and Germany constitutes an Intra-EU movement. Annex IV specifies items requiring explicit intra-community export licenses; standard sub-components falling under 3B001 for commercial civilian wafer manufacturing within EU member states do not require individual export licenses, provided the buyer provides an End-Use Certificate (EUC) confirming civilian semiconductor production and non-diversion. The EUC is attached and signed by the Dresden plant managing director. PO is approved for release.
rejected: VERIFICATION VERDICT: REJECTED FOR MISSING US ITAR LICENSE. Because semiconductor fabrication technology contains advanced optical alignment systems, all EUV spares require mandatory International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) State Department clearance and an active DSP-5 license before European purchase orders can be placed.

prompt: Verify Commercial Aviation Purchase Order PO-AV-2026-4401 in IFS ERP for CFM56-7B High-Pressure Turbine Blades: Buyer = Certified Part-145 MRO Station; Vendor = Aero-Turbine Spares LLC; Total Value = $680,000.00. Quality Clause Q-145 mandates: 'All parts must be accompanied by original FAA Form 8130-3 or EASA Form 1 Authorized Release Certificate with Dual Release status (Airworthiness / Return to Service) and full back-to-birth trace to a certified Part-121 carrier.' chosen: VERIFICATION VERDICT: FATAL REJECTION / FAA & EASA AIRWORTHINESS BREACH. PO-AV-2026-4401 cannot be released under any circumstances. Under FAA 14 CFR § 43.13 and EASA Part-M / Part-145 regulations, life-limited rotating engine components (High-Pressure Turbine Blades) cannot be installed on commercial aircraft without verified back-to-birth trace, total cycles since new (CSN), and an FAA 8130-3 / EASA Form 1 Dual Release certificate. Purchasing critical rotating parts with only a commercial bill of sale constitutes unapproved parts (BUP) risk and subjects the MRO to immediate civil aviation authority license revocation. Cancel PO requisition.
rejected: VERIFICATION VERDICT: APPROVED WITH SUBSEQUENT WORKSHOP INSPECTION. The purchase order can be released to secure the parts at market-discounted as-removed rates. Once the turbine blades arrive at the Part-145 repair station, internal NDT (non-destructive testing) and eddy-current inspection can certify airworthiness and generate an internal Form 8130-3 return-to-service release.

prompt: Audit Defense Systems Purchase Order PO-DEF-2026-19 in Deltek Costpoint for COTS Ruggedized Tactical Mission Computing Servers: End-Customer = US Department of Defense (Naval Air Systems Command); Contract Type = Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee FAR Part 15; Total PO Value = $890,000.00. Mandatory Flowdown Clause: DFARS 252.225-7009 (Restriction on Acquisition of Certain Articles Containing Specialty Metals / Berry Amendment). Vendor proposal confirms server chassis enclosure uses titanium-alloy fasteners smelted in the Russian Federation. Verify PO legality under defense acquisition regulations.
chosen: VERIFICATION VERDICT: ILLEGAL / DFARS SPECIALTY METALS & DEFENSE SANCTIONS BREACH. PO-DEF-2026-19 is prohibited by law. Under 10 U.S.C. 4863 and DFARS 252.225-7009, specialty metals (including titanium alloys) contained in items produced for the Department of Defense must be melted or produced in the United States, its outlying areas, or a qualifying country (listed in DFARS 225.003). Russia is not a qualifying country and is subject to comprehensive defense trade restrictions. Placing an order with Russian-melted titanium violates statutory defense procurement regulations and constitutes a False Claims Act liability. Reject vendor proposal.
rejected: VERIFICATION VERDICT: APPROVED UNDER COTS EXCEPTION. Because the ruggedized tactical servers are commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) computers, they qualify for the standard commercial hardware de minimis exemption under FAR Part 12. Fasteners account for less than 1% of total server weight, allowing the procurement to proceed without specialty metal tracing.
